name: justinpriday.containers
description: Worktree-bound container controls and consoles for Docker Engine and Docker Compose.
tagline: Docker Engine and Compose controls for every Daintree worktree.

commands.title: Containers: Open Console
commands.description: Open a container console permanently bound to a selected worktree and its configured Docker project.

commands.title: Containers: Refresh Project
commands.description: Refresh Docker daemon and Compose container status for the active worktree.

commands.title: Containers: Start Project Containers
commands.description: Start stopped Compose containers associated with the active worktree.

commands.title: Containers: Stop Project Containers
commands.description: Stop running Compose containers associated with the active worktree.

commands.title: Containers: Restart Project Containers
commands.description: Restart Compose containers associated with the active worktree.

settings.label: Docker socket
settings.description: Optional Unix socket override. Leave empty to discover Docker Desktop, Colima, Rancher Desktop, or /var/run/docker.sock automatically.
